title: Peer source audit: AcDs extraction and route-specific semantic evidence
mode: deeper/broader primary-source research and implementation-readiness refinement
scope: Trace the current LibreDWG AcDs segment and payload-association paths in source
Check invalid-handle disposition and safe diagnostics in the peer extraction path
Refresh ACadSharp's open ACIS writer PR against the separate DXF writer issue
Reconcile peer roles and existing local Blob01 test ownership without adding duplicate CTests

sources.project: Open Design Alliance DWG specification v5.4.1
sources.observation: DataIndex rows identify records in Data segments; Blob01 pages are addressed through large-record descriptor page entries. Page headers carry total length, page start, page ordinal/count, and page data length.
sources.limits: Container structure does not define ACIS topology or semantic validity.

sources.observation: The segment parser reads directory and DataIndex/schema/search metadata, leaves _data_ and blob01 segments unhandled, then scans the section for ACIS BinaryFile/end markers and consumes queued has_ds_data modeler handles. The resolver returns null for invalid handles, while the AcDs scan logs o->name before its null check. Issue #1411 reports SAB loss for a generated AC1032 path pinned to LibreDWG 0.14.8593.
sources.limits: No source build or malformed-handle reproducer was run. The log-order concern is an unconfirmed peer hardening lead, not a confirmed defect or a local finding; marker/queue extraction is not an ODA DataIndex-to-owner proof.

sources.observation: Issue #1195 reports DXF writer omission of 3DSOLID/REGION; PR #1240 remains open, has no deployment, and its visible serializer change is in DwgObjectWriter. The PR links to the issue but does not establish a released DXF writer fix.
sources.limits: An unmerged branch is a design lead, not a positive comparator result. DWG and DXF writer directions remain separate.

sources.observation: ezdxf documents a limited ACIS entity subset and loss of unsupported entity data. FreeCAD's maintainer states stock FreeCAD cannot read embedded ACIS solids and closed the support request as not planned.
sources.limits: ezdxf raw-carrier handling is not arbitrary semantic round-trip; stock FreeCAD ACIS remains out of profile.

sources.observation: The existing matrix covers the direct/blob threshold, one-page exact cap, and two pages totaling cap+1. The generated graph-preservation profile additionally checks suffix preservation and malformed page start, absent page segment, and header page-data-size cases.
sources.limits: This is structural/byte-preservation evidence only, not independent B-rep semantics or native application qualification. The focused graph test was green in the immediately preceding implementation pass and was not rerun during this research-only turn.

planImpact.implementationSummary: Clarified that LibreDWG's marker/queued-handle extraction is not an ODA record-owner proof, captured an unconfirmed nullable-handle diagnostic concern as peer-only, separated ACadSharp's DXF omission report from its unmerged DWG writer PR, and removed the need for duplicate Blob01 threshold CTests.
planImpact.nextImplementation: Continue with the existing fast local queue. Reuse the matrix and graph-preservation test owners; do not wait for peer merges or native/semantic gates.

method.limitations: Peer branches and online documentation are mutable. No peer behavior or semantic geometry result was independently reproduced.
